author: cens0r3d
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Bandcamp!

Setup: nothing is required. Bandcamp's own mobile API answers without a token, so `[p]bandcamp album untrue` works right away — the cog needs no Python package beyond what Red already ships.

Usage: `[p]bandcamp search <query>` (alias `[p]bc`) lists artists, albums and tracks with a menu that opens the picked entry, `[p]bandcamp album|track|artist <query or link>` opens a full view, `[p]bandcamp discography <artist>` walks every release, `[p]bandcamp lyrics <track or album>` reads the lyrics, `[p]bandcamp play <track>` posts the track's preview as a playable file (the Play menu on a release does the same), and `[p]bandcamp link <url>` opens whatever a link points at. Every command also works as `/bandcamp …`.

Optional: `[p]bandcamp autoembed on` makes the bot answer pasted Bandcamp links with an embed (off by default, limitable to one channel), `[p]bandcamp set perpage <1-25>` sets list length.

Data: guild settings only in Red's Config, cached answers in memory. No Discord user data leaves the bot.
name: Bandcamp
short: Search Bandcamp: releases, tracklists, artists and lyrics.
description: Browse Bandcamp from Discord. Search artists, albums and tracks and open a picked entry from a menu; read a release with its cover, price, tags, credits and a fully linked tracklist; open a single track; walk an artist's or label's discography; read the lyrics of a track or of a whole album; post a track's preview as a playable file via a Play menu on every release; and resolve any bandcamp.com link without an API token. Every command works as a prefix command and as a slash command, and an optional link preview answers pasted Bandcamp links with an embed. Answers are cached in memory, and expected failures (nothing found, a link that does not resolve, rate limits, timeouts) come back as an embed instead of a traceback.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild settings only (results per page and the automatic link preview setting with its channel list) in Red's Config. Search queries and Bandcamp answers are cached in memory for up to 30 minutes and dropped when the bot restarts. Queries are sent to bandcamp.com; no Discord user data leaves the bot.
